items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: So, Cricket came back and when he came back he grabbed me and kissed me and he said, 'Son, I hope this will be a stepping stone in life for you, you know.'

ctx.x: You see. And we all made, what you call today auditions. That is when the band, the St. Marks Brass Band played and he would come and listen to us, and choose, and -I happened to be one that was selected to be in this orchestra, this band. And the soloist of this new band was Cricket Smith. You heard of him?
